trinket.sortTip: Group linked trinkets into pairs, then sort by rarity, name, and ID. Saving writes the order to the profile.
trinket.alreadySorted: The trinkets are already in this order.
trinket.searchPlaceholder: Search ID, name, effects, mod, or tags; regex: /term/i
trinket.onlyNew: Only add trinkets not already in the chest
trinket.hiddenEffects: This trinket's effects are marked hidden and may be changed dynamically by the game. Check the game to confirm.
trinket.batchAddHint: The list below is a preview. Left-click to select or deselect. With selections, only selected items are added; otherwise, all visible results are added. Searching keeps selections; changing the Mod, class, or rarity clears them.
trinket.batchDeleteHint: The list below shows trinkets in the chest. Left-click to select; right-click to deselect. With selections, only selected items are removed. With none selected, a Mod/class/rarity filter removes visible items; without any of these filters, the whole chest is cleared. Searching keeps selections.
trinket.invalidRegex: Invalid regular expression. Check the pattern (for example, /bleed/i).
hero.rowHint: Click for hero details; drag to reorder; right-click to delete, Shift+right-click to skip confirmation.
hero.addHint: Selected classes are added when selected; otherwise all visible classes are added.
hero.noSafeTemplate: No class definition in the current content environment meets the resolve-level-zero starter requirements.
hero.noChanges: No hero classes are available for the current filters.
errors.HERO_TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE: The selected class is missing equipment or skill definitions needed to build a resolve-level-zero hero.
errors.HERO_REFERENCED: This hero is still referenced by another save field and cannot be safely removed.
